thought.text: Now let me verify the container stack end-to-end through the proxy (port 80):

reasoning_content:
Next, I'll verify the container stack end-to-end via the proxy (port 80):
1. Backend API health check
2. Keycloak realm
3. MeiliSearch, LocalStack, etc.

action.command:
echo "=== Backend API health (port 80 proxy) ==="; curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "GET /health -> %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:80/health -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== Keycloak realm ==="; curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "GET /realms/swcode -> %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode" -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== Keycloak token endpoint metadata ==="; curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "GET /realms/swcode/.well-known/openid-configuration -> %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/.well-known/openid-configuration" -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== MeiliSearch health ==="; curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "GET /health -> %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:80/health" -H "Host: meilisearch.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== Mailpit ==="; curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: mailpit.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== Backend login (seeded admin) ==="
curl -sS --max-time 15 "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=urbo-frontend&username=test@test.de&password=test" | head -c 200
